data.one_liner: State management and dependency injection library for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides tools for managing simple and complex application states, dependency injection, and reactive programming without boilerplate or code generators.
use_when: You want state management and dependency injection without code generation tools.
You prefer linking the lifecycle of a StateNotifier to its listeners rather than specific routes.
You want an easy-to-test state management alternative.
avoid_when: You need built-in navigation features, as the navigator module was removed in favor of packages like go_router.
You prefer using Riverpod or Bloc for your state management needs.
strengths: Manages state without boilerplate or code generators.
Includes built-in dependency injection and reactive programming support.
weaknesses: Recent major version updates introduced breaking changes, removing features like the Navigator module and SimpleNotifier.
Smaller ecosystem and community compared to alternatives like Riverpod or Bloc.

alternatives.name: flutter_riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: Widely adopted, robust state management and dependency injection ecosystem for Flutter.

alternatives.name: flutter_bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Popular predictable state management library based on the BLoC pattern.

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard, simple inherited widget wrapper for dependency injection and state management.
